changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: What a review pinned, who reads it, and the setup that started it (ADR 0167 decision 2). Nullable, and nothing writes them yet: a review without them reads as operational if it is a scan or a trial, and as personal otherwise.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The values and how they pair: a team audience names its team project and no other audience names one, the audience and the kind of version come together, and only a scan pins a repository commit. NOT VALID here and validated in the next change set, so that no lock on review waits for a scan of every row. The setup key keeps tenancy and leaves the review when its setup goes.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Every existing row has none of the new values, so each check holds. Validation reads the rows under a lock that lets writes run.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: For every writer: the team of a team audience is a standing team project of the review's workspace, as review_setup_team admits its teams, and a review keeps the audience, the kind of version and the setup it was created with. The team is a plain id with this check and no key, because Practice Review does not depend on the project module (ADR 0138). The setup may only go to NULL, as its key does when the setup goes, and a review never gets a setup after it was created. Only a review from before may get its audience and kind of version once, which a later backfill does. An update that keeps the team is not checked again, so a team project removed later does not hold up its reviews. Update guards only validate, so they run after the row write.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A delete of a review setup sets setup_id on its reviews to NULL, and without this index it scans review. Only reviews that a setup started carry one.
changeSet.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_review_setup; CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_review_setup ON public.review (setup_id, workspace_id) WHERE setup_id IS NOT NULL

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_review_setup
